We need to determine appropriate crimes from the list based on facts.

Facts: A construction project, a group led by defendant Li and others blocked construction, causing conflict, beating two people causing light injuries, and causing 8 days stoppage with loss 144,057 yuan.

Potential crimes: "故意伤害" (intentional injury) for causing light injuries. Also "破坏计算机信息系统"? No. "破坏财物"? They caused damage to construction, causing loss. Could be "故意毁坏财物" (intentional destruction of property). The loss is from stoppage, not necessarily physical destruction but interference with business. Could be "诈骗"? No. "行贿"? No. "受贿"? No. "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫"? No. "拐卖妇女、儿童"? No. "拐骗儿童"? No. "非法持有毒品"? No. "非法组织卖血"? No. "非法获取公民个人信息"? No. "走私普通货物、物品"? No. "信用卡诈骗"? No. "危险物品肇事"? No. "滥用职权"? No. "非国家工作人员受贿"? No. "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章"? No. "侵犯著作权"? No. "盗窃"? No. "破坏计算机信息系统"? No. "诈骗"? No. "组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫"? No.

Thus likely "故意伤害" and "故意毁坏财物". In earlier example, similar case with assault and property damage gave both. So answer: [罪名]故意伤害;故意毁坏财物<eoa>

Check list: "故意伤害" and "故意毁坏财物" are present. Yes.
